top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Required Documentation for Unitary Surfacing Materials (26 TAC §746.4913)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is missing the testing data for the inpact rating for the unitary surfacing.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of the investigation, the operation was found deficient with this Minimum Standard. A caregiver utilized inappropriate language when referring to a child.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have form 2985 notarized.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies lacked information regarding parent rights.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants (26 TAC §747.501(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include infant safe sleep.
